data.name: Aryav
data.gender_notes: Aryav is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aryav is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'arya', meaning noble or ruler. In Hindu mythology, Aryav is the name of a divine king, son of Indra, the god of thunder and rain. The name Aryav carries the meaning “Noble, ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Aryav usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes leadership, courage, and a connection to the divine.
data.etymology: Aryav belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aryav total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
